metadata.name: MOS Primitive DRC - Minimum Required Set
metadata.description: Critical DRC rules for validating single NMOS/PMOS transistor layout correctness

priority_levels.P0: Critical - Device function failure if violated

mos_primitive_rules._comment: Priority P0 - Absolutely critical for device function

P0_rules.description: Gate poly must extend beyond Active on both sides (endcap)
P0_rules.failure_impact: Gate does not fully cover channel → severe leakage or device failure
P0_rules.verification_method: For each poly-active intersection, measure poly overhang on active edges

P0_rules.description: Contact must be enclosed by Active (source/drain contacts)
P0_rules.failure_impact: Contact outside diffusion → open circuit or extremely high resistance
P0_rules.verification_method: Check contact bounding box is inside active with ≥0.05um margin

P0_rules.description: Contact must be enclosed by Active on at least two opposite sides
P0_rules.failure_impact: Insufficient contact enclosure → contact resistance too high
P0_rules.verification_method: Check contact has ≥0.06um margin on at least two opposite edges of active

P0_rules.description: Contact on Poly (gate contact) must be enclosed by Poly
P0_rules.failure_impact: Gate contact outside poly → open gate connection
P0_rules.verification_method: For contacts on poly (not on active), check ≥0.05um poly enclosure

P0_rules.description: N+ select must enclose Active for NMOS
P0_rules.failure_impact: Incomplete N+ implant → source/drain not properly doped → device won't turn on
P0_rules.verification_method: For NMOS, check Nselect completely covers active with ≥0.12um margin

P0_rules.description: P+ select must enclose Active for PMOS
P0_rules.failure_impact: Incomplete P+ implant → source/drain not properly doped → device won't turn on
P0_rules.verification_method: For PMOS, check Pselect completely covers active with ≥0.12um margin

mos_primitive_rules._comment_P1: Priority P1 - Important for reliability and yield

P1_rules.description: Gate spacing within same Active (source/drain length)
P1_rules.failure_impact: Insufficient source/drain length → no room for contacts or punch-through
P1_rules.verification_method: Measure distance between adjacent gate edges within same active region

P1_rules.failure_impact: Too small active → process window issues, potential device failure
P1_rules.verification_method: Calculate area of each active polygon, flag if < 0.02 um²

P1_rules.failure_impact: Gate too narrow → high resistance, potential break
P1_rules.verification_method: Measure minimum width of poly in gate region (poly AND active)

P1_rules.failure_impact: Channel length too short → short channel effects, high leakage
P1_rules.verification_method: Measure gate length in direction crossing active

P1_rules.failure_impact: Contact too small → high resistance, reliability issues
Active too narrow → high resistance, process issues
P1_rules.verification_method: Measure minimum width of active polygon

mos_primitive_rules._comment_P2: Priority P2 - Interconnect quality (important when routing beyond single device)

P2_rules.failure_impact: Poor M1-contact overlap → increased resistance or open circuit
P2_rules.verification_method: Check M1 covers contact with ≥0.005um margin on all sides
Measure minimum width of M1 shapes

mos_primitive_rules._comment_P3: Priority P3 - Mainly for array/dense layouts

P3_rules.verification_method: Measure edge-to-edge distance between separate active regions
P3_rules.note: Critical for multi-device layouts; less important for single isolated device

P3_rules.description: Poly to Poly spacing (not in same active)
P3_rules.failure_impact: Poly lines too close → potential bridging
P3_rules.verification_method: Measure spacing between separate poly lines
P3_rules.note: Important for dense arrays; less critical for single device

P3_rules.failure_impact: Metal lines too close → shorting risk
P3_rules.verification_method: Measure edge-to-edge distance between M1 shapes

typical_nmos_structure.description: Typical layer stack for a valid NMOS transistor

required_layers.role: gate crossing active to form channel

topology.gate: Poly crosses Active perpendicular, forms channel
topology.source_drain: Active regions on both sides of gate
topology.contacts: On source/drain active and optionally on gate poly
topology.implant: Nselect must cover entire active region

typical_pmos_structure.description: Typical layer stack for a valid PMOS transistor

required_layers.role: gate crossing active to form channel

additional_requirements.rule: Active must be inside Nwell for PMOS

topology.gate: Poly crosses Active perpendicular, forms channel
topology.source_drain: Active regions on both sides of gate
topology.contacts: On source/drain active and optionally on gate poly
topology.implant: Pselect must cover entire active region
topology.well: Entire device must be inside Nwell

step2.name: P0 rules - Critical geometry
step2.fail_if: Any P0 rule violated → device will not function

step3.name: P1 rules - Reliability
step3.warn_if: Any P1 rule violated → yield/reliability risk

step4.name: P2 rules - Interconnect
step4.warn_if: P2 rule violated → routing quality degraded

step5.name: P3 rules - Array/spacing
step5.info_if: P3 rule violated → OK for single device, fix for arrays

usage_notes.single_device: For isolated MOS: P0 and P1 rules are mandatory. P2 optional. P3 can be ignored.
usage_notes.device_array: For MOS arrays: All P0, P1, P2, P3 rules should be checked.
usage_notes.integration: Load this JSON in check_nmos_gds.py and iterate through rules by priority.
usage_notes.limitations: This set does not cover: well spacing, latch-up, antenna, density, ESD. Use full Calibre deck for tapeout.
